summary: Backend-only review of iter120 1h follow-up scans. Ran full pytest suite (562 passed, 121 skipped, 2 failed + 10 errors — exactly the documented env-blocked HTTP tests, no regressions vs 524+38 baseline). Verified the updated tests/test_iter114_candle_scheduler.py (72 tests: TestNextTrigger, TestSchedule, TestClosedCandles, TestContextHierarchy, TestLiveCandle, TestFollowUpGuards) all pass, plus tests/test_iter119_range_edge_fit.py untouched. Added independent edge-case suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter120_followup_scans.py (38 tests) covering: next_trigger boundaries (exactly at mark, 1s before, midnight UTC roll-over, long idles between :25:05 and next :00:05), forming_minute parity for non-1h timeframes at every boundary (0/5/10/15/20/25/26/59s), live_candle fallback when the exchange has not yet published the forming row (frame ends on last closed candle) or ATR=0, stage-1 fingerprint includes forming minute so every follow-up re-calls stage1 even without price movement, funnel_opened skip keyed by closed candle_ts so the next hour auto re-evaluates, cooldown math (min(DEEP_COOLDOWN_SEC, FOLLOW_UPS[tf][0]-30)=270s inside 1h, 300s for 15m), and Signal.context.funnel.live_candle persisted on follow-up BUY. funnel.py production code was reviewed and NOT modified.
critical_code_review_comments: funnel.next_trigger uses strict `t > now`, so landing exactly at a mark correctly advances to the next one — verified for every 1h mark incl. :25:05 → +1h :00:05.
forming_minute correctly returns None at HH:00:05 (close scan) because the `every <= sec` check is `300 <= sec`, so sec<300 => None; verified at second-level granularity.
funnel.live_candle robust against missing forming row and zero ATR; the `run` loop degrades to closed-candle-only metrics gracefully (new regression test added).
Stage-1 fingerprint `(candle_ts, minute)` ensures the cheap model is called again on every follow-up even with zero price movement — important given the forming candle changed. Verified.

funnel_opened skip key is the closed candle_ts; because the closed candle_ts rolls to the new hour at HH+1:00:05, the pair is automatically re-evaluated the next hour without any explicit cleanup. Verified.
Cooldown math `min(DEEP_COOLDOWN_SEC, FOLLOW_UPS[tf][0] - 30)` yields 270s for 1h, so the 5-min-spaced follow-ups are never swallowed. 15m path untouched (300s).
No off-by-one bugs found. No dead code around FOLLOW_UPS. No issue with midnight UTC roll-over (floor-division on UTC epoch handles it naturally).

Minor nit (not a bug): `forming_minute` and `live_candle` compute `now // step * step` and `sec // 60` using float math; still safe for the 1h step=3600 case but a future `30m` follow-up configuration would need revisiting the `every * count + 60` upper bound (currently 300*5+60=1560 > 1800/2, would overlap). Not in scope now.
